Updated by hand only. market-stats/check_redfin_reports.py runs with the monthly Market Stats refresh (the 20th): it flags newer Redfin reports for the two Redfin series every month, and checks for a new Cost vs Value edition from September through December. It opens a GitHub issue when it finds one and never changes the site.
